issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other - Water 42,376.39 (p1), Sewer 30,232.43, Garbage 19,446.72 (p2)
issues.issue: These are the only receipts of the water, sewer and garbage funds, so they are almost certainly utility charges. Local Receipts is a context label, so it needs a page-checked context decision rather than staying in other. The same applies to detail[19], detail[22] and detail[24].
The VFD Fund portion (58% of the governmental line) is likely rural fire contract payments or donations. The page gives no breakdown, so this is a context-check candidate, not an error.

issues.on_page: Line 3 Subtotal of Beginning Balance (Net Cash Balance + Investments)
issues.issue: beginning_cash and ending_cash (366,223.70) are the line 3 / line 24 balances, which include investments. beginning_investments (38,480.89) and ending_investments (38,538.62) are also filled. The notes say the investments are 'already inside', but downstream sums of cash + investments would double count them. The printed Net Cash Balance for governmental funds is 361,057.64 at the beginning (sum of the p1 line 1 governmental columns) and 327,685.08 at the end.

The Street and VFD capital outlay detail lines are labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>', but the General Fund (5,290.00) and Ballroom Fund (detail[15], 7,000.00) lines keep a plain 'Capital Outlay' label. The capital outlay rule calls for 'Capital Outlay: General Government' / 'Capital Outlay: Culture/Recreation' by fund function.
CDBG is a federal block grant passed through the state. It is kept as printed ('State Receipts: State Aid'), which is defensible, but it could be federal grants.
